character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪后半叶，参展时长19年，诞生自11月14日秋。展出地点为苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟莫斯科，近期巡展于世界多地。
尺寸：67 21/64×103 17/32×27 61/64in.
介质：伏特加
香调：馥奇香调 肉豆蔻 血橙 广藿香
灵感：流星的驱驰[星] 骑帚翱翔

character_data.title: “飞翔的可能性”
character_data.text: 看似陈旧，却拥有一双崭新翅膀的飞行员帽。那高高昂扬的羽翅，也许能让我们一窥飞行女巫的……不，是飞行女巫“们”集体的心愿——仰视着向往的天空，不断接近它、融入它……直至超越它。

character_data.title: 芝诺中尉披风
character_data.text:
做工优良、一丝不苟且保暖性能极佳的军用厚呢披风。“不过，比起用其来裹住身体，我更喜欢它在高空被风吹得猎猎作响。”受访者道。
“这让我觉得我在飞，没什么比这更重要了。”受访者喝下一口“生命之水”，顺便补充道。

character_data.title: “不记名的勋章”
character_data.text: 芝诺为空军一线指挥员颁发的杰出服役勋章，每一条边缘均被打磨得足够光洁、银亮。然而，受访者一开始拒绝接受它，直至颁发者表明，这不仅是为她，更是为所有曾担任过此职位，但并未来得及授勋的同僚们而颁发，受访者才勉强接受。

character_data.title: 附身
character_data.text:
这是神秘主义中难以避而不谈的一个环节。
在一个古老的教派中，真正的存在来自更久远的天上，肉身非但不是生命的主宰，反而是意识的悲惨囚笼。一些炼金术师则认为肉体本身是一座空置的容器，随时欢迎伟大灵魂的栖居。
无论观点如何分歧，“灵魂”的存在是无法否认的事实，类似降灵术等与“灵魂”沟通的神秘术层出不穷。在19世纪，无数自诩可以通灵的技术涌现，古老的仪式被翻新，又获得新名字、新分类——“注灵术”正是其中之一。

第二场“暴雨”落下后，白鸽也开始以自己的方式调整“灵魂”，他们将“灵魂”视作记忆与意识的总和，将来自⬛⬛⬛的数据直接输入额叶，灵性则被视作可忽略不计的微小变量。他们将这种技术命名为“灌体”。
可如果有一位真正的降灵术大师在场——无论是十九世纪的桌灵转还是骇人听闻的科学实验，都不会让他产生丝毫感触，因这之中没有任何亡灵被召唤。
那么在所有实验中，究竟是什么在影响个体的意识与记忆？无论是注灵术还是灌体，究竟是什么在操纵并影响精神？这些仪式或实验所涉及的“灵魂”，究竟是什么？

character_data.title: 你是谁？
character_data.text:
（红弩箭中尉的私人笔记本。每隔数页便会出现不同的字迹，部分内容被反复划去、重写。页面边缘留有大量观察记录，疑似用于辨别“外来者”的反应。）

布狄卡
英勇无畏的女士。历史上没有留下她是否是神秘学家的记录。
你们当中有人又开始重复那句——“没有记录，不代表不存在。”
第三次了，同一个声音。排除。

狄瓦娜
狩猎女神，这只是我们那边流传的民间传说。但写下这个名字后，你们立刻分成了两派，有人坚信她的存在，也有人觉得神话只是迷信……这倒挺有意思，至少证明你们并不共享同样的记忆。

布伦希尔德
北欧传说，还是《尼伯龙根之歌》？又或是二者皆是？
……
停顿了四秒，没有争论，看来这个名字让你们达成了一致。
很好，至少你们尊敬她、恐惧她。我记下来了。

捷列什科娃
够了！我正在寻找“古老、强大的神秘学家”，不是活着的人。
看下一个。

character_data.title: 开战宣言
character_data.text:
狩勋女巫红弩箭：我记得你。
狩勋女巫红弩箭：没想到你们的杂志还在继续出版。
白雪松：我从你的语气中听出了赞扬。
白雪松：你并非我们的读者，我以为你早就把我们抛之脑后了。
狩勋女巫红弩箭：人很难忘记一张会说话的嘴巴，我是说，一张独立的嘴巴。
白雪松：我会把这话当作夸奖。
白雪松：说说你吧。最近这段时间，关于你的传闻很多。
狩勋女巫红弩箭：哦？我倒是没听说过，他们都说什么了？
白雪松：他们的声音很大，你该少喝些酒了。
白雪松：有人说，你从城堡带回来了什么东西。
狩勋女巫红弩箭：当然。荣誉和胜利。
白雪松：也有人说，不是你带回了什么，而是有什么借着你回来了。
白雪松：还有人担心，总有一天，你会被自己带回来的东西彻底摧毁。
狩勋女巫红弩箭：嗤。
狩勋女巫红弩箭：我不会输。

character_data.title: 胜利之翼
character_data.text:
延展的双翼象征着天空的力量，在转动角度时，隐约可见头冠上折射出的虹光。
这份荣耀并非谁人慷慨的赐予，而是受访者从命运手中夺下的战利品，由她亲手为自己加冕。

character_data.title: 追猎之矛
character_data.text:
装点着橄榄叶的长矛，传说能追上任何躲藏起来的猎物。
目之所及、长矛所指，便有胜利降临；长靴所踏、车轮所碾，便有敌人的恐惧蔓延。

character_data.title: “征途的决心”
character_data.text:
在战车疾驰之时，这些垂落的衣袍总会随风鼓起，让受访者犹如一只翱翔的红羽巨鸟。
一如古老的喻示，在登上战车前，她已领受过世俗的指引，亦历经心灵的抉择。在足量磨砺后，其必胜的意志当如旗帜般飘扬空中。

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 嘿，谁说“老狗学不会新把戏”？#0|我已经等不及要前往新的战场了——#2.83
character_voice.encontent: Who says you can't teach an old dog new tricks, huh?#0| I'm itching for the battlefield now—#3.83

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 天气带来的低可见度是把双刃剑。#0|但抛开战术不论，下点小雨是挺舒服的。#3.06
character_voice.encontent: The low visibility caused by rain can be a double-edged sword in a dogfight.#0|But in here, it's pretty cozy.#5.33

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 看，这是超音速客机Tu-144，能载着一百来人一眨眼抵达目的地。#0|假如我未来退伍后不得不靠民航工作维生，那我希望这伙计至少别太让我失望。#5.58
character_voice.encontent: The SST Tu-144 can get over a hundred passengers where they're going in the blink of an eye.#0|Guess if I have to turn to civil aviation someday, flying one of these wouldn't be the worst gig.#7.4

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 看，这是超音速客机Tu-144，能载着一百来人一眨眼抵达目的地。#0|假如我未来退伍后不得不靠民航工作维生，那我希望这伙计至少别太让我失望。#5.58

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 嘿？别在这儿杵着睡觉——#0|你打算等下倒在我身上吗？#2.85
character_voice.encontent: Hey, don't fall asleep on your feet—#0|What are you going to do, fall on me?#2.85

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 嗨，大忙人。#0
character_voice.encontent: Hey, busy bee.#0

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 我是不用早起去赶训练了，但该死的是我成了负责训练的人……#0|更没懒觉可睡了！#4.77
character_voice.encontent: Haven't had to get up for early training for a while ... But now I'm the one leading it.#0|Guess my days of sleeping in are over.#6.45

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 我见过最美的日出——那时候我正吊着一桶奶油在三千英尺的高空上为一群蠢货做冰激凌。#0|虽然连我都差点被冻成了老冰棍，但好在风景和冰激凌的滋味都还不赖。#7.65
character_voice.encontent: The most beautiful sunset I've ever seen was at 3,000 feet—I was trying to freeze a bucket of cream for a bunch of idiots.#0|Almost turned myself into a popsicle in the process, but the ice cream was pretty good, and the view even better.#10.52

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 我见过最美的日出——那时候我正吊着一桶奶油在三千英尺的高空上为一群蠢货做冰激凌。#0|虽然连我都差点被冻成了老冰棍，但好在风景和冰激凌的滋味都还不赖。#7.65

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 至少今晚，没有人必须为了放哨而干巴巴地和星星大眼瞪小眼。#0
character_voice.encontent: At least no one's got to crane their necks to keep watch tonight.#0

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 为什么晚上会有这么多呆瓜杵在荒原上？想对着流星许愿？#0|呵，我去取扫帚，过会儿就让你们看到一颗恰到好处的流星——#5.1|别忘了想好要许的愿望，头儿。#10.28
character_voice.encontent: What are those goofs doing standing around in the Wilderness? Waiting for a shooting star to make a wish on?#0|Hah, just wait till I grab my broom—I'll give them a shooting star all right. #6.87|Better start thinking up your wish now, капитан.#12.65

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 我走过的战场越多，惦记这颗脑袋的人也就越多。#0|嗯哼，让他们慢慢惦记吧。#4.62
character_voice.encontent: The more battles I fight, the more people want to see my head on a stick.#0|Hmph. Well, let them keep wanting.#4.6

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 红弩箭中尉现在确实不需要用拳头来讲话了，#0|但我还是时刻准备着将它们抡起来，送到某些混蛋脸上。#3.28
character_voice.encontent: "Lieutenant Lilya" may not need to talk with her fists, #0|but I'm always ready to swing them at any smug bastard who gets in my way.#4.07

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 这里本应有的那枚徽章被我拒绝了，于是这里一直空着。#0|我看别一个司辰小队的章就不错——头儿？#4.46
character_voice.encontent: I refused the medal they wanted to give me, so this spot's stayed empty.#0|A Team Timekeeper pin would look pretty nice there, though. What do you say, капитан?#4.85

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 最好每天都是谢肉节，数不清的布林饼和肉冻砌成小山，而我就骑着红色38去取山顶最新鲜的那一盘。#0
character_voice.encontent: If every day was Maslenitsa, I'd ride Red 38 to the top of the mountain of blini and kholodets and take the freshest plate from the top.#0

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 我手下的人里有不少刺儿头，让我想起来刚到芝诺不久的我……#0|我开始想要你这种不用动拳头就能让别人服服帖帖的本事了，头儿。#5.48
character_voice.encontent: I got a couple troublemakers in my team. Reminds me of myself when I was a rookie ...#0|Got to say, I'm starting to wish I had your knack for getting people to listen to you, капитан.#8.26

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 嘿！别把我以前在箱子里的糗事跟那群新兵蛋子讲……！#0
character_voice.encontent: Hey, uh ... don't tell the rookies what I've done in the Suitcase, okay?#0

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 我教了玛尔纱一些驾驶Su-01ве的基础操作，#0|她看上去对能飞上天空感到很高兴——抛开她回到地面后被我搀回箱子不谈，#3.55|到底是谁告诉她可以用神秘术去压制晕机感的！#9.38
character_voice.encontent: Taught Marsha some Su-01ве basics a while back.#0|She seemed pretty into it when she was flying, but I had to carry her all the way back to the Suitcase after she landed.#4.14|Who told her it was a good idea to block airsickness with her arcane skill?!#11.9

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我从不打算为了任何人放缓自己的脚步，就算是头儿你也不行。#0|但同样，谁也不能按着我的脑袋让我对一些混蛋的事视而不见。#5.56
character_voice.encontent: Nobody can slow me down, not even you, капитан.#0|There isn't a single living soul who can force me to turn a blind eye to what I know is wrong.#3.98

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 我清楚，只要我稍有懈怠，我的身体就会不再属于我。#0|但猎物和猎人可不是绝对的，祂最好也警惕着我的獠牙……#5.68
character_voice.encontent: The moment I let my guard down, my body won't be mine to control anymore.#0|But the hunter can be the hunted, too. And this "prey's" got fangs ...#4.83

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 决定打出王牌了？#0
character_voice.encontent: Playing your ace card, huh?#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 红色38进入轨道，完毕。#0
character_voice.encontent: Red 38 on course, over.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 你说了算，头儿。#0
character_voice.encontent: Your call, капитан.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 没事，我盯着呢。#0
character_voice.encontent: Relax, I got an eye on them.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 火控雷达照射中！#0
character_voice.encontent: FCR's locked on!#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: ——啊哦，这下可难收场咯。#0
character_voice.encontent: Uh-oh, this is going to end badly.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: Fox 2！#0
character_voice.encontent: Fox 2!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 该清理下空域了。#0
character_voice.encontent: Time to clear the airspace.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 一点新把戏。#0
character_voice.encontent: A new trick I picked up.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 哈哈！#0
character_voice.encontent: Haha!#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 出发！#0
character_voice.encontent: Поехали!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 一点小麻烦。#0
character_voice.encontent: Pft. That's nothing.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 嗯？挠痒痒呢？#0
character_voice.encontent: Hah! You trying to tickle me?#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 没人掉队？很好。#0
character_voice.encontent: No one left behind? Good.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 我就知道，你肯定不会对我吝惜最好的燃料。#0
character_voice.encontent: I knew you wouldn't skimp out on the good fuel.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 我身后确实多了位有点聒噪的邻居，#0|我们互相厮杀着，也合作着——#2.7|虽然这关系算不上和睦，但我仍能为你带来无数的胜利。#5.4
character_voice.encontent: Heh, got myself a noisy new "neighbor." #0|We fight each other, but we also fight side by side.#3.42|Not a friendship, exactly, but it sure gets us where we need to go.#7.46

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 我身后确实多了位有点聒噪的邻居，#0|我们互相厮杀着，也合作着——#2.7|虽然这关系算不上和睦，但我仍能为你带来无数的胜利。#5.4
character_voice.encontent: Heh, got myself a noisy new "neighbor." #0|We fight each other, but we also fight side by side.#3.42|Not a friendship, exactly, but it sure gets us where we need to go.#7.46

character_voice.name: 特殊交互1
character_voice.content: 我和我的“新邻居”打了个赌，赌我能经受住永不间断的风暴。#0|你会为我下注吗，头儿？#4.46
character_voice.encontent: I bet my new "neighbor" that I can make it through the never-ending tempest.#0| You in on the bet, капитан?#5.03

character_voice.name: 特殊交互2
character_voice.content: 真令人失望，不过一场毛毛雨……连你的帽子都没吹掉。#3.6
character_voice.encontent: Just a drizzle, how disappointing ... Didn't even blow off your hat.#3.6

character_voice.name: 特殊交互3
character_voice.content: 呃……嘿！我还没认输呢，再来一轮！#0
character_voice.encontent: Ugh ... Hey! I'm not down yet! Give me another shot!#0

character_voice.name: 入场
character_voice.content: 和某种强大的意识搏杀将成为我后半生习以为常的活动。#0|每从祂的身上撕扯下一片血肉，我就越接近一道真正的流星——#4.2
character_voice.encontent: Wrestling with this colossal being will be a daily thing for the rest of my life.#0|Each time I tear off a piece of her, I get closer to being a real shooting star.#5.25

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 这台轰鸣的发动机已经无法停下，#0|但能在熟悉的港湾稍微停泊，就是对我来说最好的保养了。#2.9
character_voice.encontent: Nothing is stopping this rumbling engine now. But for me,#0|a moment or two of rest in a familiar place is the best maintenance.#3.47

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 哪有什么一帆风顺的最佳天气，#0|湍流、气旋、山地波、强风切变……#2.42|甚至是不小心路过的一只倒霉鸟，都有可能让飞行器瞬间失控。#5.68|我们有的，不过小命一条罢了。#10.26
character_voice.encontent: There's no such thing as safe weather for a flight. Even when it's sunny and clear like this,#0|turbulence, cyclones, mountain waves, and wind shears are always a possibility. #5.57|You can get in real trouble just from a bird passing by. #11.45|That's why good pilots keep themselves in control at all times.#15.29

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 我其实没想过自己的职业规划，比如升官发财之类的，#0|和那些扑克脸说话让我头疼。#4.28|不过我唯一能确定的就是，无论最终做了多大的官，你都是我永远的头儿。#7.19
character_voice.encontent: Don't care about my career. Even less about promotions or money.#0|Just the idea of having to socialize with those grim-faced armchair generals gives me a wicked headache. #4.85|But there's one thing I do know for sure: No matter what position they put me in, you'll always be my boss.#12.32

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 嗯，嗯……我已经习惯这种大眼瞪小眼状态了，一种维尔汀式的交流方法？#0|那句话怎么说来着——“和真正的朋友在一起，哪怕不说话也很舒服。”#7.88
character_voice.encontent: Yeah, I'm getting used to this "Vertin-style" communication—just gazing into each other's eyes wordlessly.#0|What do people say? "True friends find comfort in quiet intimacy." That's what this is, right?#8.2

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 嘿，要出去兜风吗？保证不需要买保险的那种。#0
character_voice.encontent: Come on, join me for a ride. Don't worry, капитан, there's no insurance needed. You have my word.#0

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 大早上着什么急？有我和红色38在，别怕赶不上时间。#0
character_voice.encontent: What's the rush? Red 38 and I will get you there on time. Wherever, whenever.#0

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 什么是完美的早晨？#0|首先，没有宿醉的头痛，其次，不用被一帮新兵蛋子追在屁股后面喊长官，#4.25|没有写不完的报告、开不完的会……#11.13|噢，如果有人来找我，记得说我在“外出公干”。#13.9
character_voice.encontent: A perfect morning?#0|First, no hangover; second, no getting followed around by rookies, #3.64|no endless paperwork, and no meetings ...#10.43|Oh, if anyone is looking for me, tell them I'm on a "business trip."#14

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: “飞到大气层外”听着还算是件值得干的事。#0|老伙计，我们就以月亮为目标如何？#4.12
character_voice.encontent: Flying up into the stratosphere sounds challenging enough. #0|Where to next, old pal? The moon?#4.81

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 多么适合对饮的时刻——#0|别那副表情，不然给你来杯牛奶？#2.39
character_voice.encontent: A perfect moment for a stiff drink—#0|Oh, don't give me that look. What would you prefer? A cup of warm milk?#3.72

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 这头盔虽然经常勾住我的头发，#0|但是看在它这么拉风的份上，算了。#2.87
character_voice.encontent: My hair keeps snagging in this helmet.#0|But it looks so cool that I can't stay mad.#2.56

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 驾驭冷兵器需要更极致地掌控身体，引导力量一瞬间爆发而出。#0|说实话，这和起飞很像。#6.37
character_voice.encontent: Wielding a lance requires control and awareness: you need to guide it, hold it steady, and strike at the perfect moment.#0|It's a lot like taking off, really.#9.05

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 看来不管发生什么，你爱摆弄人的习惯还是没变。#0
character_voice.encontent: Guess you'll never really kick that habit of pulling on people's strings.#0

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 听说古时候的战士凯旋会喝一种只用蜂蜜酿出来的好酒，#0|是传说中的众神之饮，#4.8|有机会真想尝一尝。#7.32
character_voice.encontent: In ancient times, warriors toasted their victories over drinks brewed with honey, like mead, I guess.#0|Back then people said it was the nectar of the gods.#8.44|I got to try it sometime.#12.47

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 如果在这里囤上吃不完的罐头、喝不完的酒，#0|简直可以安享退休时光到一百岁了……#3.41|开玩笑的，我们都是停不下来管闲事的人，对吧？#6.4
character_voice.encontent: You know, if we stocked this place up with enough tin cans and booze, #0|I figure we could hole up in here for a hundred years. Call it retirement ... #4.7|Ah, who am I kidding? We're not the kind to hang up our wings.#10.35

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 听说星锑的午夜派对申请你都给批了，#0|那我这个伏特加无限量供应的申请能不能给过下？#3.6
character_voice.encontent: So, you approved Regulus's all-night party application, didn't you?#0|How's my unlimited vodka fountain any worse than that?#5.52

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 那些新兵总是崇拜地望着我，好像羡慕我走了狗屎运。#0|他们不会知道这份奇迹的代价，也不会知道——这不是祂赐予了我，而是我征服了祂。#5.23
character_voice.encontent: Looking out at those rookies' faces, I saw envy, as if this power were some kind of luck.#0|They'll never know the price I paid for it—everything I got, I took for myself.#7.04

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我还在芝诺上学的时候，军队每年还会庆祝空军节，#0|全城的居民都会涌来观看我们的飞行表演……#4.7|你说得对，我怀念那段日子。#9.42
character_voice.encontent: Back when I was still a flight cadet in Zeno, they used to hold a celebration for the Air Force each year.#0|People would turn out in droves to watch our flight show ... #7.3|You're right. I do miss it.#12.21

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 曾经我最讨厌叫我收敛、克制、守规矩的人，#0|但现在，当你坐在一辆永不停止的战车上，身后又跟着那么多信任你的人时，做决定就要更谨慎点了……#3.96|不只是为了别人，也为了自己不会后悔。#14.38
character_voice.encontent: I used to think anyone trying to control me or make me follow orders was just an uptight jerk.#0|But now that I've got an unstoppable chariot and a whole bunch of rookies who trust me with their lives ... #6.86|I finally get it. I'm making decisions about life and death. I have to be cautious, for them and for myself.#14.16

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 听说你需要一场胜利，所以我来了。#0
character_voice.encontent: Heard you need a win. Well, here I am.#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 一场狩猎要开始了。#0
character_voice.encontent: Let the hunt begin.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 嗯？谁是下一个？#0
character_voice.encontent: Hmm, who's next?#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 让我们都认真点儿。#0
character_voice.encontent: Strap in and buckle up.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 热身完毕。#0
character_voice.encontent: Warm-up's over.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 跑吧，再跑快点——#0
character_voice.encontent: Go on. Run faster.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 别挡路！#0
character_voice.encontent: Keep out of the way!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 百发百中。#0
character_voice.encontent: Red 38 never misses.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 来吧，一起加速。#0
character_voice.encontent: Let's get speedy.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 追上光？也不难。#0
character_voice.encontent: Catch the horizon? Consider it done.#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 因为我比死神还快！#0
character_voice.encontent: Outrunning the reaper.#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 再来！#0
character_voice.encontent: Another!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 还差得远。#0
character_voice.encontent: Not even close.#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 不知道这辆战车能装下多少战利品，#0|不过肯定包你满意。#2.8
character_voice.encontent: Not sure how much loot this chariot can carry,#0|but I guarantee you won't be disappointed.#2.82

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 胜利会更快飞到你身边。#0
character_voice.encontent: Now victory will arrive even faster.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 如果这是一场永恒的战争，我总会是赢到最后的那一个。#0
character_voice.encontent: Even if this war lasts forever, I'll be there, standing victorious at the end of time.#0

character_voice.name: 特殊交互1
character_voice.content: 我和祂的厮杀还没结束——#0
character_voice.encontent: This war between her and me isn't over yet.#0

character_voice.name: 特殊交互2
character_voice.content: 头儿，你看我们像战友吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: Hey капитан, what do you think? Do we look like real comrades now?#0

character_voice.name: 特殊交互3
character_voice.content: 看来祂今天战意不高，建议喝点蜜酒兑伏特加。#0
character_voice.encontent: Guess she's not in the mood today. Maybe I'll try to win her over with some mead or a shot of vodka.#0

character_voice.name: 入场
character_voice.content: 红色38将以全新形态出击！怎么样，听起来够拉风吧。#0
character_voice.encontent: Red 38 blasts off again! How cool does that sound, huh?#0

skin.name: 狩勋女巫红弩箭
skin.skinDescription: 她只是比我们更早走上这条航路，循着她的笑声，跟紧她。

skin.name: 狩勋女巫红弩箭
skin.characterSkinNameEng: The Arrow That Sunders the Tempest
skin.skinDescription: 她麾下的“小天才”们闯了点小祸，不过那对她而言同样无伤大雅。

skin.name: 虹色冠冕
skin.skinDescription: 胜利女神也无法轻言永远的胜利，但心脏雀跃着说：我能。
skin.skinStory:
战争常以凯旋与希望诱人向前，又以死亡迫人止步。

血与火舔舐过荒芜的土地，遮蔽昼夜的尘沙里，她再度升空，驶入她的征途。
那是意志与勇气缺一不可的道路，无数灵魂曾被命运绊倒，无数灵魂曾因恐惧而消融。但在征途终点，那或可被视作战利品的不朽声名，也将会成就永恒的生命。她不再揣度，亦不再试探，只是随战车疾驰——
如果曙光是胜利的象征，那她就会升于曙光之前；如果胜利女神乘彩虹而至，那她的尾迹也将先虹色一步，铺于长空。

传说世上不曾有神祇能够许诺长久的凯旋，但车轮未歇，她仍立于天际，向光明处望去——
skin.subTitle: singlebg_lang/txt_skinhandbook_singlebg/skinsuitdetailview_title_taluo.png

1401011.content: 嘿，头儿！来看看我焕然一新的老伙计！
要我说，这真是有史以来最炫酷的战利品。
没错！马力强劲，上限刷新，比导弹飞得还要快！
地心引力已经拦不住我了，我感觉可以一口气飞到月亮上去。
唯一算得上小麻烦的，也就是太空里没有氧气了。
是吧！老伙计翻新之后，我考虑了很多种涂装样式。
比如翅膀形状的流线线条，或者一颗暴烈的太阳。
最后想来想去，还是觉得简单点好，这可比给我自己挑衣服困难多了！

1401012.content: 没什么，我的任务还剩了点收尾工作——祂正揪着我不放呢。
我天生就擅长这个——我巴不得多看几次祂被我打败的样子。
要是担心我，就给我多配几箱好酒做军需物资吧。
收到指令，保证胜利归来。
哈哈哈，头儿，你板着脸的样子还挺像回事儿的。
放心吧，无论多少次，我都会顺利返航的。
